title: Function template compiles for some T and not others — SFINAE constraint
notes:
Forces the extraction prompt's rule #2 (one spec per primary
template, quantified invariants) AND rule #3 (quantifier +
behavior_on_violation honest about what fails). The Java target
has to either restrict T (`<T extends ConcatableT<T>>`) — verbose —
or file an Open Question suggesting JNA per ADR-027.
